mapper.insert: INSERT INTO user_follow (id, follower_id, followee_id, is_deleted, create_time, update_time) VALUES (#{id}, #{followerId}, #{followeeId}, 0, NOW(), NOW()) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE is_deleted = IF(is_deleted = 1, 0, is_deleted), update_time = IF(is_deleted = 1, NOW(), update_time)
mapper.select: SELECT uf.followee_id FROM user_follow uf INNER JOIN user_follow rev ON rev.follower_id = uf.followee_id AND rev.followee_id = uf.follower_id AND rev.is_deleted = 0 WHERE uf.follower_id = #{userId} AND uf.is_deleted = 0 AND uf.followee_id != #{userId} ORDER BY uf.create_time DESC
